name: normalized_dotdot_token_check
description: Checks for absolute components, then normalizes the joined path and rejects it only if a literal '..' token survives normalization. Since posixpath.normpath collapses every resolvable '..' for an absolute base, this check almost never fires: e.g. base "/srv/data", part "../etc/passwd" normalizes straight to "/srv/etc/passwd" with no '..' left, so the escape sails through silently. A realistic 'missing validation' bug: the author normalizes but never actually compares the result against base.
